Paychex Flex Recruiting: Applicant Tracking and Hiring Tools

Recruiting software can help organize the hiring process from job posting through the transition to onboarding. In this video, see how Paychex recruiting and applicant tracking supports job creation, applicant evaluation, hiring team collaboration, job-board distribution, and status updates. The demo also shows how employers can connect recruiting with employee background checks and screening and employee onboarding software as candidates move toward becoming new hires. You can also explore additional Paychex Flex demos to see other capabilities across the platform.

Topics:

  • 0:00 Paychex Flex Hiring Tool Overview
  • 0:08 Job Posting and Team Management
  • 0:25 Job Board and Social Distribution
  • 0:42 Candidate Application Process
  • 0:51 Hiring Team Collaboration and Updates
  • 1:02 Employment Verification and Background Checks
  • 1:14 Mobile and Desktop Onboarding Tasks
  • 1:41 Paychex Flex Hiring Contact Information

<p id="transcript-button">View Transcript</p>

Paychex Flex Hiring Tool Overview

0:01 Attract top talent in today's labor market with Paychex Flex Hiring tools.

Job Posting and Team Management

0:08 Post a new job with relevant details. Then choose your desired process template. Add managers to evaluate applicants, and get notified as they move through the process. So everyone is on the same page.

Job Board and Social Distribution

0:25 Now, share it to popular job boards, casting a wide net. Once published, the opening is immediately available from your company job portal. From there, it’ll be easily searchable on the web. You can also share it on social media.

Candidate Application Process

0:42 And applying is a breeze. Candidates upload their resume and cover letter, add details, and then submit.

Hiring Team Collaboration and Updates

0:51 Your hiring team can be kept informed with status updates and collaborate with comments and ratings that are stored privately on the applicant's profile.

Employment Verification and Background Checks

1:02 Hire with confidence. Learn about an applicant's history quickly with employment verification, and offer background checks and drug testing through our relationship with HireRight.

Mobile and Desktop Onboarding Tasks

1:14 Once screened, prompt your new hire to complete onboarding tasks conveniently from mobile or desktop, giving them a positive impression of your company. Remember, in this labor market, they’re evaluating you too. Hire and retain an engaged workforce with help from a single system to post jobs, collaborate with your team, screen your applicants, and onboard your next superstar.

Paychex Flex Hiring Contact Information

1:41 Contact us today to see how Paychex Flex Hiring can help simplify your recruiting needs.

Keep Your Hiring Process Organized From Job Post to New Hire

Explore Paychex applicant tracking and recruiting tools for job posting, candidate management, reporting, and the transition into onboarding.
